senses.gloss:
(I)--(God सुब्रह्मण्य, सेनापति) a son of अम्बिका (पार्वति) was born as साम्ब, son of कृष्ण. तीर्थ sacred to, in the सरस्वती visited by Vidura.
1: भा. III. 1. २२. and ३०. Br. III. २४. 4; IV. ३०. १०४; वा. ३०. ३१५; ३९. ५५, ४१. ४०; Vi. V. ३३. २६.
Guha is said to hve shot arrows at क्रौञ्च hill.
2: भा. V. २०. १९.
Fought with तारक in the देवासुर war and with Pradyumna at शोनितपुर.
3: Ib. VIII. १०. २८; X. ६३. 7.
Relieved Mucukunda defending Heaven.
4: Ib. ५१. १६.
With peacock as riding animal, defended त्रिपुरारि's chariot; birth of, in a शरवन, as a baby of seven days killed Asura तारक.
5: M. १३३. ६४; १४०. ४०; १४६. १०-11; २६६. ४२.
Weapon शक्ति.
6: Vi. III. 2. १२.
[page१-540+ २५]
(II)--the ruler of kingdoms Kalinga, महिष, Mahendranilaya, etc. Br. III. ७४. १९८; वा. ९९. ३८६.

--cave (golden) in कुहरिणि in Meru where व्यास composed the four Vedas having conquered hunger, mind and आसन; after one hundred years of contemplation the Vedas came to him in their full form. वा. १०४. ६७-9.
--rule over Kalinga, माहिष, and Mahendra hill regions. Vi. IV. २४. ६५.
--on the northern side of the निषध hill. वा. ४१. ५५.
--a ऋत्विक् at the sacrifice of ब्रह्मा. वा. १०६. ३९.

--the अवतार् of the Lord in the seventeenth द्वापर in the सिद्धक्षेत्र of the Himalayas; with four sons all ब्रह्मज्ञस्; each of the latter had a number of disciples, all engaged in महेश्वर yoga. वा. २३. १७५-7. [page१-541+ ३८]

--demons and followers of Kubera,
1: भा. I. 9. 3; X. ३४. २८; II. १०. ३७; IV. 4. ३४.
who reside in Himalayan valley.
2: Ib. IV. 5. २६; १०. 5.
Magic relating to;
3: Ib. X. ५५. २३.
followers of शिव;
4: Ib. ६३. १०.
attain heaven by association with the righteous;
5: Ib. XI. १२. 3; १४. 5.
are यक्ष-ra1ks2as;
6: Br. III. 7. १६७; IV. 2. २६. M. १३. १७; १२१. 2.
their habits and duties;
7: M. १८०. 9; २४६. ५३.
born out of Deva- janani and मणिवर and their issue.
8: वा. ६९. १६२; १०१. २८.
राक्षसस्.
9: Br. II. 8. ३३; वा. 9. ३२; ३०. ८४.
